test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that arranges the given sentences in the correct sequence. The first sentence is in the correct position.**

A. An ancient sage was teaching his disciples the art of archery.

B. The first disciple was then asked to describe what he saw.

C. He asked his disciples to aim at the eye of the bird.

D. He put a wooden bird as the target on the branch of a tree.
solution:
The correct answer is "ADCB"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let's look at the correct sequence of the passage. 
 
• Statement A is the opening sentence of the passage which explains that **A wise man from long ago was instructing his followers in the art of archery.**
 
• Statement D is the second sentence of the passage which explains that **On a tree limb, he set a wooden bird as the target.**
 
• Statement C is the third sentence of the passage which explains **He instructed his followers to shoot at the bird's eye.**
 
• Statement B is the last sentence of the passage which shows that **The first disciple was then questioned as to what he had seen.**

Hence, the correct sequence is A, D, C, B

The correct answer is option 1.

The correct passage is: ***A**. An ancient sage was teaching his disciples the art of archery. **D**. He put a wooden bird as the target on the branch of a tree. **C**. He asked his disciples to aim at the eye of the bird. **B**. The first disciple was then asked to describe what he saw.*
